title: EDG Community Update: Week of November 22nd
body:
**Highlights**
- [Kabocha's roadmap](https://twitter.com/HeyEdgeware/status/1462917942211923970?s=20) is now publicly available.
- The [trading competition on Kucoin](https://twitter.com/HeyEdgeware/status/1463549989427322883?s=20) concluded on 25th November.
- [The waitlist is now open for Kabocha](https://www.kabocha.network/), the Kusama parachain from the Edgeware ecosystem.
- All validators are requested to upgrade their nodes to the [release v3.3.3](https://github.com/hicommonwealth/edgeware-node/releases) to proceed further with the ERUP4/Wako upgrade through the on-chain governance. The core community dev Ramsey recently shared [the docker image for v3.3.3 aka ERUP4/Wako upgrade](https://twitter.com/HeyEdgeware/status/1438226365833175048?s=20) to save the compiling hustle for node/validator owners.
- Get to know more technical oriented updates on the ‘[Developer Update aka EDG Dev Digest](https://blog.edgewa.re/edg-developer-update-nov-21/)’.


**Ecosystem Updates**
- [Clover’s bridge](https://twitter.com/HeyEdgeware/status/1464066137981956132?s=20) is coming to the Edgeware ecosystem.
- Zien’s [Unreleased Selfies Drop and Avatar (Alexa) Auction](https://twitter.com/joinzien/status/1463137084491898880?s=20) are now live.
- OnFinality had a new [UI revamp and functionality upgrades](https://twitter.com/HeyEdgeware/status/1463608612945907722?s=20).
- 4thPillarTech [expanded to Polygon](https://twitter.com/4thtechProject/status/1464198336827768836?s=20).
- Community members interested in running bridge relayers or Chainlink’s oracle nodes on Edgeware, please reach out to ops@edgeware.agency.
- Community members interested in running [Webb Protocol](https://www.webb.tools/)’s transaction relayers on Edgeware, please reach out to drew@webb.tools.


**Governance**
- No active referendum. Upcoming: [Kabocha Technical Steward - Treasury Proposal](https://gov.edgewa.re/proposal/discussion/2515-kabocha-technical-steward-treasury-proposal/), [GMI it in crypto media](ht
